architectureNotes: The document says functions operate on "arrays of finite numbers". Neither sum nor mean (src/stats.js:4-14) checks that its input is finite or numeric, so the condition is a caller precondition, not an enforced one. For example, mean([NaN]) returns NaN, so the § Errors guarantee that a function "never returns NaN" holds only for valid input. This changes no decision. Later units should follow the same precondition reading unless the requester wants input validation.
